name: Staff Sergeant grade on the 2 in OCP square
size_citation: CAPR 39-1 7.1.1.2.1 (ICL 25-06): grade insignia on 2" x 2" dark blue material, front of the OCP coat, centre of the chest. The 2 in square is regulation; the chevron scale is estimated.
estimated: Chevron scale on the square (the regulation gives no size for NCO grade on the OCP square); source chevron is the 3 1/2 in measured form.

mounts.rule: 2 in x 2 in dark blue square at the centre of the chest, between the name tape and CAP tape (7.1.1.2.1); asset baseline rotation 0
